meta_description: Harry's Gardening Service in Liverpool. Professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and seasonal care. Local, reliable, friendly service. Call today.
hero_subhead: Expert garden care in Liverpool — from overgrown borders to beautiful outdoor spaces that add real value to your home.
services_heading: Complete Garden Care Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From one-off tidy-ups to year-round maintenance, we handle everything your garden needs.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly cuts, hedge trimming, and border care to keep your garden looking sharp all year. We work around your schedule and handle the lot — you just enjoy the space.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim that wilderness. We clear brambles, dead wood, and years of neglect safely and responsibly. Waste is disposed of properly, and we leave you with a blank canvas to work with.

services.title: Landscaping & Garden Design
services.desc: New borders, pathways, raised beds, and planting schemes tailored to your space and lifestyle. We listen to what you want and create gardens that actually work.

services.title: Lawn Care & Treatment
services.desc: Scarifying, aeration, seeding, and seasonal treatments for a thick, healthy lawn. A good lawn transforms the whole garden — we'll get yours there.

services.title: Seasonal Work & Pruning
services.desc: Winter tree work, autumn leaf clearance, spring planting, and expert pruning of shrubs and fruit trees. Every season brings different tasks — we've got them covered.

services.title: Garden Tidy-Ups & Spring Clean
services.desc: One-off blitzes to refresh your space — perfect after winter or before guests arrive. Fast, efficient, and thorough.

about_pullquote: I started out because I loved gardens and hated seeing them neglected.
about_para_1: I'm Harry, and I've been gardening professionally in Liverpool for over 15 years. I started this business because I was tired of watching neighbours' beautiful gardens fall into disrepair. Now I look after everything from small city plots to larger suburban spaces — and every garden gets the same care and attention.
about_para_2: Customers come back to us because we're reliable, we turn up when we say we will, and we genuinely care about the work. I'm not just cutting grass — I'm helping you create an outdoor space you actually want to spend time in. No jargon, no upselling, just honest gardening done well.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Harry's been maintaining our garden for three years now. He's reliable, fair-priced, and genuinely knows his plants. We used to dread the spring tidy-up — now it's one less thing to worry about. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Cleared an absolute jungle of a back garden in one day. Harry was professional, efficient, and left the place spotless. He even gave us advice on what to plant next without trying to charge extra. Top bloke.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Called Harry on a Friday for an overgrown borders job we needed done urgently before a party. He fitted us in the following Tuesday and did a beautiful job. The garden looks completely different. Will definitely be using him again.
reviews.author: Rachel K.
